_comment: The evaluation run configuration WITH the ex-ante prediction gate ([I10]).
Identical to scripts/benchmark.json except that a predictGate task sits between
pyScan and the first LLM stage, so the gate scores every job before a single
token is spent. It reads the vector pyScan already recorded rather than scanning
again, which is what makes its marginal cost the inference alone (~1.6 mJ, [I8]).
IMPORTANT - enforce defaults to FALSE here on purpose. In this configuration the
gate scores and records every job and changes no outcome, so the run stays
directly comparable to every section-H baseline AND accumulates (score -> outcome)
rows. Turning enforcement on produces a different denominator and destroys the
evidence for exactly the functions it refuses; do it only when the point of the
run is to demonstrate the gate acting, and never for a baseline.
Requires: predict.enabled true and a model exported by

tasks._comment: pyScan is required here, unlike the dev pipeline: a benchmark job without a feature vector is a row [I4] cannot use, and discovering that after a 3-hour run is worse than failing fast.
Must be a descendant of pyScan: the gate reads the recorded feature vector and fails closed if there is none.

testRouter, not goTester: 40 of the 95 evaluation_set functions declare setup/sideEffects and can only be validated through the Floci route. Naming goTester directly would send them to the black-box tester, which ignores those assertions with a warning and reports a pass that validated nothing.
